title: Thin and floppy
text: Thin and floppy. I'm not very impressed with this item, mainly because it is a very thin and floppy silicone sheet. It comes folded, and is so thin I was afraid to pull it apart for fear it would rip. Its ok as a working mat underneath you, but I was also wanting to use this in a general way...like as a cover for a casserole & baking pan, but its so thin that it just 'flops in'. Its basically as thin as one of those bendable plastic cutting boards that you can buy at the dollar store.
